title: Rook Slides to Mate
setup: Your rook and king against three black pawns, with Black's king still sitting behind them on g8. One move is enough.
hint: The king cannot step off its back rank. Put your rook on that rank with check.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Re8#}} is mate in one. The rook leaves the second rank and checks along the eighth: f8 and h8 are on its line, f7, g7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns, and no black piece can capture or block.

When the enemy king sits behind a row of unmoved pawns, look for a rook check on the back rank first.
